title: Let automated case bindings record artifacts outside the project with a recorded fingerprint (#14)
description: Let automated case bindings record artifacts outside the project with a recorded fingerprint (#14)
acceptance_criteria: A command or agent-assisted case MAY declare an artifact as an absolute or home-relative path outside the project; the run copies or links nothing into the repository, records the artifact's path, size and SHA-256 fingerprint in the observation, and refuses when the path is missing or unreadable. Project-relative artifact behavior, artifact caps and digests are unchanged. An external artifact's later change is detectable from the recorded fingerprint.
